A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

the water content and dynamics, as well as the static disorder of the hydrates, play a key role in determining the stability and transformation pathways of DB7, and that these factors must be taken into account in the rational design and development of hydrates.

the thermodynamics and crystallographic structures of the two zirconium zwitterionic crystalline hydrates (HyA and Hy2) and three neutral anhydrate phases (Forms I, III, and II°) are highly dependent on the water activity and pH, and that the transformation pathways are complex.
